$Comment: The top rollable tier: rare enough that a kill should feel like an event. DifficultyMultiplier 2.4 folds a legendary at 2.4 times the spot's difficulty, so at a spot of 30 it reads the curve at 72, takes nearly twice as long to kill as a plain mob there and hits nearly three times as hard; because that product is never clamped to the difficulty cap, a legendary keeps its lead over an epic all the way to the top of the scale. Multipliers.Loot 2.0 rolls the Loot block twice, so the native Mmoscaling_Drops_Legendary table pays out twice per kill. A good place for a headline extra: add a roll with a low Chance and its own Grants (an exact item in Items, a console line in Commands, or a registered reward kind in Rewards) for the once-in-a-while prize on top of the table.
